architecture.falsification_test: Conduct an accelerated engine dynamometer durability test on factory-filled engines using the modified oil formulation under simulated low-oil-pressure conditions; measure crankshaft bearing clearance and surface roughness after 500 hours to verify absence of bearing material loss compared to baseline production oil.
